title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.30161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. translated_title: TauIndianBankBench：流程感知、动作导向的工具使用型对话智能体评估
translated_abstract: 许多印度银行通过常见问题（FAQ）页面和脚本化聊天机器人来服务客户。基于语言模型的助手能够更快地响应并执行诸如冻结银行卡之类的请求，但前提是它们必须提供正确的信息并遵守银行的规定。这些规定定义了一套流程，即一系列必需的步骤，例如在关闭存款账户之前必须先获取结息报价。要将模型适配到这一领域，就需要在训练前后衡量其遵循流程的能力。现有的基准测试通常只根据对话结束时留下的记录进行评判。然而，许多必需的步骤并不会改变记录，因此跳过这些步骤的助手仍可能被判定为成功。我们提出了 TauIndianBankBench，这是一个面向动作的基准测试，包含 1,000 个印度零售银行任务，其中助手需要帮助一位模拟客户。除了最终记录之外，该基准还会检查助手是否执行了每一个必需的步骤，并且没有做出任何未经请求的更改。
tldr: 该论文提出了 TauIndianBankBench，一个包含 1,000 个印度零售银行任务的面向动作的基准测试，它不仅检查对话的最终记录，还检查助手是否完整执行了所有必需的流程步骤且未做出任何未经请求的更改，从而更准确地评估工具使用型对话智能体对银行流程的遵循能力。
en_tdlr: TauIndianBankBench is an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks that evaluates tool-using conversational agents by checking not only the final records but also whether every required procedural step was taken and no unrequested changes were made.
